_published_faq.name: How do I add Kindora Funder Discovery to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kindora Funder Discovery to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://kindora-mcp.azurewebsites.net/mcp/.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Kindora Funder Discovery scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kindora Funder Discovery MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kindora Funder Discovery provides these MCP tools: search_funders, get_funder_profile, get_990_summary, get_foundation_grants, get_ntee_codes, get_funder_stats, list_tools, and health_check.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kindora Funder Discovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kindora Funder Discovery in nonprofit on the Manufact MCP catalog include Granted, hacesfalta, Benevity, Candid, and Chariot.

_published_faq.name: Does Kindora Funder Discovery MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kindora Funder Discovery does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
